segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour sign-on, identifies as the dog producer, and cues Amongst the Web.

segments.title: Executive Order Roundup
segments.notes: Case and Rick methodically read through Trump's day-one executive orders covering immigration, energy, DEI, federal workforce, January 6 pardons, TikTok, WHO withdrawal, and geographic renamings.

segments.title: Pat Robertson Dust Séance
segments.notes: Case attempts to interview the sentient dust of Pat Robertson via Pepito's retrieval; the dust manifests as a pixelated Japanese penis prop before dissolving into hellish flesh-soup rhetoric.

segments.title: Viral Video Review Marathon
segments.notes: Case, Rick, Tyler, Kendall, and Kyler react to acapella crash-outs, a forehead-gem piercing, a brutal head-bonk challenge, skin-stretching routines, AI North Korean propaganda, and a deep-dive investigation into a 2015 high-school 9/11 cheerleading tribute.

segments.title: Drinkable Mayo & Schedule Talk
segments.notes: Case and Tyler cover Japan's nomu mayo drinkable mayonnaise, debate Kolpi luwak pricing, and discuss upcoming schedule changes including a potential murder-mystery sub-goal payoff.

segments.title: Scent, Breathing, Oil & Kissing
segments.notes: Jeb and his wood-trapped father present how-tos on pheromone cologne (Molecule 01), vaginal scent vials, purse-lip breathing sponsored by National Jewish Health, cornstarch oil recycling, and soft-kissing communication tactics.

segments.title: Unfiltered Finale with JD Vance Parody
segments.notes: DJ Newsic performs auto-tune-free set; Pepito throws voice; Newsic delivers vulgar JD Vance rap about couch relations, Peter Thiel, and deportations before raid sign-off.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case announces raid destination; DJ Newsic signs off from roof; broadcast ends with lingering JD Vance scent joke.

characters.name: Pepito

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: host of Amongst the Web. Co-anchors the executive order read-through, hosts Amongst the Web, and orders Kendall an iced matcha latte with oatmeal and lavender syrup.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walks through the studio during a work meeting, reveals she was in Queens on 9/11, and later dismantles the studio backdrop while filming content.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: Joins as guest co-host for Amongst the Web and the drinkable mayo segment, later reveals his brother Kyler on camera.

characters.name: Kyler
characters.notes: guest. Makes a brief on-camera appearance as Tyler's brother, works in marketing, receives a butterfly kiss from Tyler.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosts How To with Jeb from his woodshop alongside his deceased father trapped in a board, covering scent products, breathing, oil recycling, and kissing advice.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: recurring. Argues with Jeb from inside the wood, requests vaginal scent be dumped on his wooden prison.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: recurring. Performs an auto-tune-free musical finale featuring a vulgar JD Vance parody rap before signing off.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell relaunches Barely Informed News on a Monday/Wednesday/Friday 11am schedule, joined by Rick to dissect Trump's blizzard of executive orders on immigration, energy, DEI, and January 6 pardons. The broadcast spirals into a Pat Robertson dust séance, an extended Amongst the Web that forensically investigates a 2015 high-school 9/11 cheerleading tribute, a taste-test of Japan's drinkable mayonnaise, and a How To with Jeb covering pheromone cologne, vaginal scent vials, and kissing diplomacy. DJ Newsic closes with a broken auto-tune set and a vulgar JD Vance parody rap before raiding out.
